hero.caption:
Aerial view to the south-southwest of the former Hamilton Air Force Base in Novato, Marin County, California. The base was closed as an U.S. Air Force base in 1974 and sold by the U.S. Government in 1988. The old runway is still visible in the distance. 
Part of the base is in the Whiteside marsh wetlands restoration, in the Hamilton Wetland Restoration Project of the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers.

images.caption: F-104As of the 84th FIS, Hamilton AFB CA.  F-104A Starfighters fly in formation near Edwards AFB in early 1958. One airplane has the markings of the Air Force Flight Test Center on its vertical tail.  Other three aircraft could be pre-delivery aircraft for Hamilton's 83rd FIS, the first USAF squadron to fly the Starfighter in operational service.
images.alt: F-104As of the 84th FIS, Hamilton AFB CA.  F-104A Starfighters fly in formation near Edwards AFB in early 1958. One airplane has the markings of the Air Force Flight Test Center on its vertical tail.  Other three aircraft could be pre-delivery aircraft for Hamilton's 83rd FIS, the first USAF squadron to fly the Starfighter in operational service.
